note: Incumbent Joe Lombardo (R) seeks a second term; no U.S. Senate race in 2026. Also on ballot: Danielle Ford (no party).

cands.name: Joe Lombardo
cands.desc: First-term governor and former Clark County sheriff; runs on his jobs and investment record and as a veto check on the Democratic Legislature.

cands.name: Aaron Ford
cands.desc: Attorney general since 2019; focuses on housing costs and tariffs, and says he would sign a repeal of the state's right-to-work law.
